what.title: Bipolar disorder: how common it is, onset age and time spent ill
what.description: How many people live with bipolar I, II and spectrum forms, when it starts, why depression fills most ill weeks, diagnostic delay and person-first words.

episodes.title: Mania, hypomania and depression: bipolar mood episodes explained
episodes.description: Scrub a mood chart through hypomania (4+ days), mania (1+ week), mixed features and depression (2+ weeks), and sort symptoms by pole. DSM-5-TR, cited.

genes.title: Bipolar disorder genes and family risk: twins and GWAS
genes.description: Bipolar disorder family risk from 0.48% to 43% for an identical twin, heritability, 64 to 298 GWAS loci and why no DNA test can diagnose it.

brain.title: Bipolar disorder, sleep and the body clock: brain research
brain.description: How lost sleep and routine can feed mania, what ENIGMA brain scans and dopamine show, why no scan can diagnose, and the kindling debate.

criteria.title: DSM-5-TR bipolar criteria: mania, hypomania, depression
criteria.description: Manic, hypomanic and major depressive episode criteria assembled step by step, with DIGFAST and a teaching criteria counter. Cited, not a self-test.

types.title: Bipolar I vs bipolar II vs cyclothymia: types, specifiers
types.description: Watch three life charts meet the rules for bipolar I, bipolar II and cyclothymia, overlay rapid cycling and other specifiers, and compare DSM-5-TR and ICD-11.

screening.title: Bipolar screening: MDQ, HCL-32 accuracy and the YMRS rating scale
screening.description: Follow 1,000 people through the MDQ or HCL-32 to see true and false positives and predictive value, plus the YMRS and how mood charts aid diagnosis.

differential.title: Bipolar or something else? Depression, BPD, ADHD
differential.description: How bipolar II differs from unipolar depression, borderline personality disorder, ADHD and substance-induced states, with clues and medical mimics.

lithium.title: How lithium works for bipolar disorder: mechanisms and evidence
lithium.description: Lithium for bipolar disorder: inositol, GSK-3 and neuroprotection ideas, then relapse, BALANCE, mania and suicide trial data as a forest plot, with sources.

levels.title: Lithium levels: target ranges, toxicity and interactions
levels.description: Lithium blood levels: 12-hour trough, steady state, published target ranges, toxicity signs, kidney and drug interactions, and NICE monitoring schedules.

stabilisers.title: Valproate, lamotrigine and carbamazepine in bipolar disorder
stabilisers.description: Lamotrigine titration and rash warning from the label, valproate pregnancy risks from EURAP, and the three mood stabilisers compared side by side.

antipsychotics.title: Antipsychotics for bipolar disorder: uses and side effects
antipsychotics.description: Antimanic efficacy from Cipriani 2011, the five approved bipolar depression options with NNTs, NICE metabolic monitoring and side effects compared.

depression.title: Treating bipolar depression: antidepressants, switch risk
depression.description: STEP-BD results, ISBD antidepressant advice, the CANMAT 2018 first-line ladder, switch risk with and without a mood stabiliser, ECT, ketamine and light.

therapy.title: Bipolar disorder therapy: psychoeducation, FFT, IPSRT, CBT
therapy.description: How talking therapies help bipolar disorder: group psychoeducation and STEP-BD results animated, family therapy, IPSRT routines and CBT compared, cited.

crisis.title: Bipolar disorder and suicide risk: a safety plan
crisis.description: When suicide risk is higher in bipolar disorder, what protects, and a private printable safety plan. Crisis lines: 988 in the US, Samaritans 116 123.

pregnancy.title: Bipolar disorder in pregnancy: postpartum risk, medicines
pregnancy.description: Relapse risk in pregnancy and after birth, postpartum psychosis, and lithium, valproate and lamotrigine malformation risks per 1,000 births, all cited.

course.title: Bipolar disorder course: relapse, recovery, comorbidity
course.description: A 10-year life chart of recurrence, recovery and residual symptoms, what maintenance treatment changes, and anxiety, alcohol, ADHD and heart risk.

living.title: Bipolar disorder self-care: sleep, warning signs, mood chart
living.description: Sleep loss, early warning signs and relapse-prevention plans in bipolar disorder, an animated 8-week mood chart, and a free mood tracker you can keep.

families.title: Bipolar disorder and families: FFT, carers and work
families.description: Family-focused therapy and expressed emotion explained, with 2-year relapse results, 12 cards on what helps carers, and notes on children, school and work.

nursing.title: Bipolar nursing care: acute mania and lithium monitoring
nursing.description: Nursing care in bipolar disorder: an animated acute mania day, lithium teaching cards, NICE monitoring schedules and six NCLEX-style priority questions.

frontier.title: New bipolar disorder treatments: research pipeline and trials
frontier.description: Where ketamine, light therapy, lithium-response tests, phone monitoring and new antipsychotics stand, with registered trials and evidence labels.

history.title: History of bipolar disorder: folie circulaire to lithium
history.description: Timeline from Aretaeus, Falret and Kraepelin to Cade's lithium, Angst and Perris, DSM-III to DSM-5-TR and ICD-11, and genome studies, with name changes.

review.title: Bipolar disorder flashcards and mnemonics
review.description: 88 cited flashcards on bipolar disorder by part, ten memory aids and an animated DIGFAST guide to the DSM-5-TR manic and hypomanic episode rules.

quiz.title: Bipolar disorder quiz: 94 cited questions
quiz.description: Multiple-choice quiz on bipolar disorder with cited answers: DSM-5-TR criteria, MDQ screening, lithium levels and toxicity, medicines, therapy and nursing.

glossary.title: Bipolar disorder glossary: terms from mania to lithium explained
glossary.description: 154 searchable, cited bipolar disorder terms, from hypomania, rapid cycling and the MDQ to trough lithium levels, EXTRIP, IPSRT and safety planning.

sources.title: Bipolar Companion sources: the references behind every claim
sources.description: Every journal article, systematic review, guideline, drug label and trial record behind the Bipolar Companion, searchable and filterable by research area.
